lines.t: I stood beneath the weight of my mistakes Echoes of the law I could not break
But love came running where sorrow stayed And mercy spoke, my fear decayed
No price of mine could ever pay The gift of life he gave that day
Grace it rains, unearned, untamed Fall like rain through crimson veins
I was lost, but now I see
Grace is a river washing me
Not by the work of trembling hands
But by His word, His vast commands
He called a sinner to stand up free
Grace rewrote my history
No shadow stands where light has shone
No guilt remains, His love alone
Grace it rained, unearned, untamed
Poured like rain through crimson veins
I was lost, but now I see
Grace is the river washing me
It's higher than the mountains, deeper than the grave
A promise everlasting, a soul forever safe
Grace still reigns beyond the skies
The gift of God that never dies
I fall, He lifts
I'm weak, He saves
Forever free beneath His grace
So let every breath and heart be saved
I am alive because of grace today
We'll see you next week.
Thank you.
